description: Transaction prices of flats in one city from the Real Estate Price Register (RCN), month by month or quarter by quarter: the number of transactions and the prices per m². These are prices flats actually sold for, not developers' asking prices. granularity=month (default): median and mean price per m², median area and median flat price. granularity=quarter: only the mean price per m² and the count, but a longer history. Months and quarters are different statistics: do not join them in one chart or series. Limits: flats only and whole cities only (city_slug from deweloperuch_search_locations; no districts, streets or whole Poland). Default: the latest 12 periods; truncated=true means older ones exist (raise periods, at most 60). The newest periods are incomplete (the RCN lags by months): skip a period with incomplete=true — do not quote its prices as a trend — and end a trend at last_complete_period (even its data may still change). Two kinds of prices must not be mixed: developers' asking prices (deweloperuch_search_investments, deweloperuch_get_investment, deweloperuch_get_offer, deweloperuch_get_market_statistics), RCN transaction prices (deweloperuch_estimate_property_value, deweloperuch_get_transaction_statistics, deweloperuch_rank_locations, deweloperuch_get_building) — what flats actually sold for, from the Real Estate Price Register. deweloperuch.pl is a free community project queried politely (one request at a time, results cached): if a result is an error starting with STOP, stop using the deweloperuch_* tools, retry nothing, look for no workaround and tell the user that market data is temporarily unavailable. Fields ending in _url are pages of deweloperuch.pl: give them to the user as links. Result shape: { city_slug, granularity, total, returned, truncated, available_from, last_complete_period?, hint?, note, stats_url, source, periods: [{ period ('2025-08' | '2025-Q3'), transactions, incomplete? (only when true), median_price_per_m2?, average_price_per_m2?, median_area_m2?, median_price? }] } — the list key is `periods`, oldest first; a period without transactions has no prices. last_complete_period is omitted when the history is too short or has too few transactions to judge; then read hint. Read `note` before describing a trend.

city.description: city_slug of a city from deweloperuch_search_locations, e.g. warszawa, krakow, gdansk (lowercase, no Polish characters). Whole cities only: not districts, streets or polska.

granularity.description: month (default): months with median and mean price per m², median area and median price; quarter: quarters with only the mean price per m² and the count, but a longer history.

periods.description: How many latest periods (months or quarters) to return, 1–60. Default 12. 60 months is about 9,000 characters; for a multi-year trend choose quarter.

name: deweloperuch_get_transaction_statistics
title: Transaction prices over time
